court: In the High Court of Madras
appellants: Aashi Creations, Rep., by its Proprietor Mr. Shravan Kumar Tripati … Petitioner(s);
respondents: Commissioner of Customs and Another … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Respondent(s): Mr. S.M. Deenadayalan, Sr. SC, A.M. Harsavardhini For R 1, R 2
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— Pending writ petition, the petitioner has filed a writ miscellaneous petition (WMP) No. 55826 of 2025 seeking for a direction to the second respondent to permit the petitioner to re-export the goods morefully disclosed in the prayer to the said WMP.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner on instructions submits that the petitioner is willing to give a representation for the aforesaid purpose to the second respondent.

3. No prejudice will be caused to the respondents if the petitioner's representation seeking for re-export of the goods morefully disclosed in the prayer to WMP. No. 55826 of 2025 is considered, on merits and in accordance with law, within a time frame to be fixed by this Court, pending disposal of the main writ petition. Accordingly, this petition is disposed of by directing the petitioner to submit a representation to the second respondent seeking permission for the petitioner to re-export the goods morefully disclosed in the prayer to WMP. No. 55826 of 2025, within a period of one week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. On receipt of the said representation, the second respondent shall pass final orders, on merits and in accordance with law, on the said representation, on or before the next hearing date.

Post the main writ petition for counter and disposal on 23.03.2026.
